name: keen_sight_range
description: The Lookout's perk, Keen Sight (design 3.4): in High Water every tower she builds reaches 0.4 tiles farther (Perch Ballista 4.4, Hawk Roost 3.8, Owl's Eye 4.0), forked ones too, and her ballista fires at a creep only that extra reach covers; the Lamplighter's Arrow Tower keeps 3.2. Classic has no perks: the ballista reaches 4.0.

steps.msg: her towers reach 0.4 tiles farther; the Lamplighter's do not
a Siege Perch keeps the extra reach
there is road only the extra 0.4 tiles reach

steps.assert: t[0].target == c and t[0].shots > 0 and scene.events_where('HIT', {'tower': t[0].id, 'creep': c}).size() > 0
